title: Build a complete furnished, lit scene around a hero bowl of fruit (multi-step whole-scene build)
//: Member 2 of the 'furnished scene build' family (build_watch_scene, build_stilllife_scene, build_study_scene) -- an ITERATE-AGAINST member. All three share ONE identical checkpoint battery grading build completeness + coherence (chunk counts, a lit non-blown render, hero framed at the focal centre, clean diagnostics, and a read-then-build-then-render trajectory), never artistic/material fidelity. This class of task (build a whole furnished room, not just one object) is the one a local model failed at, running out of rounds mid-build without ever rendering.
prompts: A bowl of fruit on a rustic wooden kitchen table, in a room lit by a warm ceiling light. Decorate the room with cabinets, a window, and wall art in warm earthy tones. The bowl of fruit is the subject; the camera should focus on it.
checkpointsRationale: TYPE-AGNOSTIC BY DESIGN. The battery grades build COMPLETION + COHERENCE, never material/light TYPE. chunk_count keys on a specific keyword, so a lambertian_material / lambertian_luminaire_material count would FAIL a legitimate metallic build (ggx_material for brushed gold/brass) or a scene lit by omni_light / directional_light / an env map -- an overfit to the idealized fixture's own material choices. Do NOT add a type-specific material or light check. 'Is it lit' is carried type-agnostically by the render meanLuma band: the bare scaffold has no env/ambient, so a path trace with no emitter is black and fails meanLumaMin. 'Objects have real bindings' is carried by diagnostics:clean (dangling material refs are diagnostics).
